column19: The stability analysis is well chosen because it tests a preprocessing decision that could affect the results. column20: The report uses logistic regression and a decision tree, with class balancing to account for the low positive rate. This substantially improves sensitivity compared with the unweighted models, although performance remains below that of the purpose-built PECARN rule. The stability check also shows that the preprocessing change has very little effect on either model. One limitation is that the analysis focuses mainly on standard classification metrics and does not frame the models around a decision threshold or CT recommendation, making the comparison with the PECARN decision rule somewhat less direct.
